commands.name: Write DAC0
commands.note: p.22: asynchronous mode updates the active register at CS rising; synchronous mode waits for LDAC

commands.name: BRDCAST (all channels, asynchronous)
commands.note: p.22, p.35: a BRDCAST write loads the buffer registers of the broadcast-enabled channels, which then update per their sync mode; ignored when a pair is differential

commands.name: Write
commands.note: p.26 Tables 6-2 and 6-3: R/W = 0, bit 22 don't care, A[5:0], DI[15:0]; the next frame echoes it on SDO

commands.name: Read
commands.note: p.26 Tables 6-2 and 6-3: the next access cycle shifts out RW, bit 22, A[5:0] and the register

commands.name: Write (CRC frame)
commands.note: p.28 Tables 6-4 to 6-6: R/W = 0, CRC-ERROR, A[5:0], DI[15:0], CRC

commands.name: Read (CRC frame)
commands.note: p.28 Tables 6-4 to 6-6: the next cycle shifts out R/W, CRC-ERROR (0), A[5:0], the register and the CRC

protocol.note: p.26 Tables 6-2 and 6-3: fewer than 24 (32 with CRC-EN) SCLK falling edges: ignored; more: only the first 24 (32) bits are used; data take effect at CS rising; SOFT-RESET = 1010 resets, the LDAC bit loads the synchronous-mode DACs

pages: p.2-3 (pinout), p.4 (ROC), p.9-10 (timing), p.22-23 (register structure, broadcast, clear, reset), p.26-28 (serial interface, CRC), p.29-42 (registers)
notModeled: analog outputs, output ranges (DACRANGEn stored only), reference, TEMPOUT, power-down states (DACPWDWN, DEV-PWDWN, REF-PWDWN stored only) and thermal shutdown

clear code: zero for unipolar single-ended ranges, midscale for bipolar or differential, per channel; the model takes the code for every channel from DAC0-RANGE (DACRANGE3.DAC0_RANGE), so channels with another range and differential pairs (DIFF-EN) clear to channel 0's code
ALMOUT open-drain alarm pin and the STATUS alarm bits (CRC, thermal, DAC-busy): never asserted; ALM-RESET stored only
CRC: with CRC-EN = 1 the 32-bit frames are decoded but the CRC byte is not checked, CRC-ALM is never set and the CRC byte shifted out is 0
SDO-EN = 0 (SDO not operational) and FSDO: SDO always drives while CS is low
write-only registers (NOP, DACRANGEn, TRIGGER, BRDCAST, DACn): the model returns the stored value on read-back

BRDCAST with only some channels broadcast-enabled (BRDCONFIG not all ones): only the BRDCAST register is stored, no DAC buffer is loaded; with all channels enabled and mixed SYNC-EN bits the buffers load but no channel updates until LDAC
differential mode (DIFF-EN pairs, OFFSETn stored only; writes to the odd DAC of a pair are not ignored) and toggle mode (TOGGLE0-2 pins, TOGGCONFIGn, SOFTTOGGLE-EN, AB-TOGn: Register B not modeled)
streaming mode (STR-EN = 1: auto-incrementing DAC data writes in one CS frame): only the first 24-bit frame is decoded
daisy chain beyond one 24-bit echo; the 1-ms POR delay, 2.4-us update and 4-us broadcast waits
variants: dac81416.pdf covers DAC81416 (16-bit, DEVICEID 29Ch), DAC71416 (14-bit, 28Ch, no skeleton device) and DAC61416 (12-bit, 24Ch); same pinout and register map, data MSB aligned
